a1-70.title: Communicative Challenge: And You
a1-70.scenario: Mariann phones from the park. You are at home and you are reading. She speaks very fast.
a1-70.prompt: Tell Mariann that you read and ask her back. Then ask her to speak more slowly.
cues: Say that you read and ask her back
Ask her to speak more slowly
a1-70.target: Olvasok. És te? Lassabban, légy szíves.
a1-70.english: I read. And you? More slowly, please.
a1-70.canDo: I can ask the same question back, like És te?
